newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil industrial production up in Nov-IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil industrial production up in Nov-IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian industrial production in November rose 1.1 percent from October and 5.5 percent from November 1995, the government's National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
The IBGE said industrial production was on the path of recovery, with November's production reaching the highest level in the last 20 months.
Industrial production in the January-to-November period rose 0.9 percent.
The IBGE said it expected industrial production to grow 1.3 percent in the whole of 1996, saying the increase in output was driven by greater consumer credit facilities.
Production in November increased in 13 of the 20 industrial sectors covered by the IBGE survey.
Output of capital goods increased 3.1 percent in November, while durable consumer goods rose two percent and non-durable goods increased one percent, the IBGE said.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
